FISHING LICENCE · MONACO

Monaco fishing licence

Shore anglers must declare their activity to Maritime Affairs. The current Sea Code requires renewal every three years, and fishing is restricted to authorised shore areas.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • People who fish with a line from the shore must make the declaration.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Shore fishing declarationany3 yearsSee official site

Saltwater

The shore declaration is not confirmation of permission to fish from a boat. Separate sea rules apply to other methods.

Rules visitors should know

  • Use no more than two hooks from the shore.
  • Fish only in authorised shore areas.
  • Do not sell the catch.
  • Return undersized fish, even if dead.

How to buy

Submit the shore fishing declaration to the Direction des Affaires Maritimes.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Monaco?

Shore anglers must declare their activity to Maritime Affairs. The current Sea Code requires renewal every three years, and fishing is restricted to authorised shore areas.

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Monaco?

Submit the shore fishing declaration to the Direction des Affaires Maritimes.
